title: Obys — the strip turns on its side, and titles reveal their image
note: Choosing Horizontal rotates the whole strip from vertical through a diagonal to horizontal while the brackets stay put. In this view the projects become 80px titles. Hovering one opens its image at the screen centre with clip-path: inset(50%) → inset(0) over 0.8s while the image inside scales from 1.15 to 1 over 1.6s (both cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)). Worth reusing: the diagonal moment, where the layout change itself becomes the animation, and the inset reveal with a counter-scale.
